manifesto.quote: We're a small, hungry studio that crafts unforgettable work. We believe every brand has a dormant anthem — a filmic nerve nobody's hit yet. Our job is to find it, shoot it, edit it, and launch it into the world before your audience can blink. We live for the goosebump moment: the split-second a viewer leans in and thinks, 'I need to watch that again.' That's the Molotov standard — make it once, make it sting, make it spread.

services.title: Reels & Short-Form Video
services.description: We create scroll-stopping short-form content designed for platforms like Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. From concept to final cut, our team produces high-energy, visually striking content that grabs attention in the first second. Whether it's product showcases, behind-the-scenes content, trend-driven pieces, or brand storytelling — we make sure every second counts.

services.title: Features & Brand & Documentary Films
services.description: Our feature and brand film division specializes in producing visually rich, narrative-driven content that goes beyond promotion — it creates lasting impact. We handle everything from concept development and scriptwriting to full production and post. Whether you need a brand documentary, a founder's story, a product film, or a full-length feature, we bring cinematic quality and emotional depth to every project.

services.title: Scriptwriting & Creative Concepts
services.description: Great content starts with a great story. Our scriptwriting and concept team develops compelling narratives tailored to your brand, audience, and platform. From commercial scripts and branded content to short films and campaign concepts, we craft words and ideas that connect, convert, and linger. Every script is built around strategy — not just creativity — so your message hits where it matters.

services.title: Post-Production & Content Repurposing
services.description: Our post-production pipeline covers everything from professional video editing and color grading to motion graphics, sound design, and final delivery. We also offer content repurposing — transforming a single production into multiple assets optimized for different platforms and formats. One shoot becomes a campaign, and every frame is polished to perfection.

services.title: Social Media & Performance Marketing
services.description: We don't just make content — we help it perform. Our social media and performance marketing services combine creative production with data-driven strategy. From managing social channels and creating monthly content calendars to running paid ad campaigns and analyzing performance, we help brands grow their presence, engage their audience, and drive real results across platforms.

services.title: Web Development
services.description: We build fast, responsive, and visually stunning websites and web applications. From custom landing pages and portfolio sites to full-stack platforms and e-commerce solutions, our development team brings your digital presence to life.

serviceDetailsPage.mainSubheading: Big ideas. Brighter execution. Films that shout.
serviceDetailsPage.descriptionP1: We're a production house that paints in light and sound — militant about craft, reckless about boring.
serviceDetailsPage.descriptionP2: Imagine a comic-strip panel where every frame is a film poster. That's our approach: theatrical boldness, cinematic discipline. We take projects from scribbles on a napkin to festival-ready masters — with scriptsmiths, scouts, crews and mixers who love the weird work as much as the clean one.

ourGoal.heading: Our Goal
items: Blow up mediocrity with films, reels, and shorts that ignite.
Craft cinema that refuses to be scrolled past.
Turn ideas into weapons — precise, bold, unforgettable.
Stay raw, stay cinematic, stay dangerous.

theChallenge.heading: The Challenge
theChallenge.text: The industry runs on safe bets, empty trends, and fast churn. Our challenge is to resist the bland, to carve beauty out of chaos, and to make every frame hit harder than the last. We don't adapt to platforms — we bend them. We don't follow timelines — we weaponize them. At Molotov, every project is a strike — calculated, explosive, and built to leave a mark.

steps.title: Idea Spark
steps.subtitle: The Tiny Betrayal
steps.description: Every great film starts with a line scrawled on something disposable — a napkin, a foggy window, a parking ticket. We hunt for that one unignorable thought — the hook you can't shake, the visual gag that replays in your head at dinner.

steps.title: Story Architecture
steps.subtitle: The Skeleton With Costume
steps.description: A strong video needs bones. Actual bones. We build structure: setups that tickle, turns that twist the stomach (gently), and endings that land like a deep breath after a long swim.

steps.title: Script Craft
steps.subtitle: Words That Wear Faces
steps.description: Dialogue should sound like your smart friend — the one who quotes Tarantino and still listens to your problems. We write lines that sound human, specific, and a little too real.

steps.title: Visual Blueprint
steps.subtitle: Storyboards That Sneer
steps.description: Frames that love composition and disrespect cliché. Shot lists that read like mood boards with ambition.

descriptionParagraphs: A strong video starts with an even stronger idea — and idea starts with words. Our scriptwriting team doesn't just write scripts; we write spells.
